ask.using: What do you think of it so far?

profile.does: A swipe dating app that shows you people who are actually nearby, so a match can turn into a date this week.
profile.why: Fewer, closer profiles instead of endless scrolling through people who live an hour away.

audience.who: Students and young professionals in US cities who want to meet someone nearby soon.

money.free: 5 swipes a day, matching and chat
money.paid: Unlimited swipes and seeing who liked you

ads.line: Free to start. 5 swipes a day on us.
Real people, verified with a selfie.

competition.now: The big swipe apps, where most profiles are far away or no longer active.
competition.switch: Kindred only shows people close enough to meet this week.

retention.back: A daily note when someone nearby liked you.
retention.leave: No matches nearby in the first week, or the paywall before a first match.

a.changes: Nationwide TikTok ads, paywall from day 1

b.changes: Austin, then Denver and Nashville; campus ambassadors; 30 days free

verdict.headline: Plan B wins.
verdict.reason: Concentrating launches in a few cities and letting people try it free before paying gave them nearby matches. Nationwide, people were too scattered, matched nobody, and quit. Plan B won 25 of 30 runs.
